text:
**Possibly, but the evidence does not confirm a harvest.** Hansen data show 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2023. Of that area, 0.4 ha overlaps forest mapped in 2021 as planted eucalyptus; the remaining 0.3 ha lies outside mapped forest. None overlaps mapped native forest.

The JRC map shows the entire loss area as forest in 2020, but tree-cover loss alone does not establish why the trees were removed.
